item.title: Brett Yanofsky, ROCK Water Founder: Why ROCK Exists
item.description: Brett Yanofsky, the ROCK Water founder, grew up in Scottsdale and built the water brand he could not find. Here is why ROCK exists and what it stands for.

item.title: Electrolyte Water in Phoenix, Explained Simply
item.description: What electrolytes are, why sodium, potassium and magnesium show up on labels, and how to choose an electrolyte water in Phoenix without the sugar or the hype.

item.title: What to Stock in a Scottsdale Office Fridge (and Why Cans)
item.description: A simple guide for Scottsdale offices: what to keep in the fridge, why canned spring water beats plastic jugs, and how monthly delivery takes it off your list.
